cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Strategic Retreat
cards.instruction: Describe every loss of control as a deliberate concession made from strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I've graciously handed you the chess club chairmanship. You'll need room to develop.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You lost the vote. I need the cupboard key for tonight's match.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Of course. I'm releasing equipment control so you can practice responsibility.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: And remove yourself as administrator. I can't change the fixtures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll surrender my override too. You must learn to make decisions without my safety net.

mechanism: A professionally instructs a successor while recasting lost election and demanded access removal as chosen training concessions.
confusable: Celebratory reframing finds good in setbacks; D65 specifically calls lost control a deliberate concession from strength.
comparison: Gallery alternative recasts rejection and removal as generous withdrawal; chess alternative treats forced access transfer as successor training.
seedUse: Lost chess vote, cupboard key and fixture admin removal derive from D65-a; S03 adds exact handover instruction and correction of loss wording.
